title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Our client is a U.S.-based company that provides technical expertise, testing, and certification services to the global food and agricultural industry. Their mission is to ensure food safety, quality, and sustainability across international supply chains.


They are seeking a highly skilled Senior Software Engineer to design, develop, and optimize the core APIs and data services powering their flagship SaaS platform. This role focuses requires expertise in TypeScript/JavaScript, C#/.NET and Azure cloud development practices. You will also help set technical direction, mentor other engineers, and ensure the software meets the highest standards for performance, scalability, and security.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Design and develop RESTful APIs and backend services using .NET/C# on Azure Web Apps
  • Model and manage SQL data structures (Azure SQL) to support complex engineering workflows.
  • Build responsive, accessible UI screens in HTML and TypeScript, leveraging the Webix control platform to deliver clean, maintainable front-end components
  • Implement security best practices including IAM role configuration, least-privilege access, and API authentication/authorization.
  • Write and maintain test automation to ensure code quality and reduce regression risk.
  • Participate in DevOps practices including CI/CD pipeline maintenance, infrastructure-as-code (YAML), and application monitoring using telemetry tools Application Insights and KUSTO language.
  • Leverage AI-powered assistants and developer tools to reduce repetitive work, improve code quality, and accelerate delivery.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with international teams including Product Managers, UX designers, test engineers, and DevOps.
  • Mentor team members on best practices in software architecture, design patterns, and coding standards.
  • Conduct code reviews to ensure adherence to established guidelines.


This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. Employees may be asked to perform additional tasks as required, that may or may not be related to their primary duties.


Required Qualifications:


  • BA/BS degree in a technical field or equivalent practical experience
  • 5+ years of professional experience developing SaaS applications.
  • 2+ years in .NET/C# for developing RESTful APIs.
  • 2+ years Web API, JSON, and TypeScript consuming RESTful APIs
  • Proficiency in version control tools (e.g., Git) and Agile development practices.
  • Experience with SQL databases such as SQL Server / Oracle
  • Ability to work independently in short delivery cycles with minimal rework.
  • Strong understanding of software architecture and design patterns.


This is a CRT Role at R$18,000/month + Annual Bonus

A Getronics é líder global em soluções de tecnologia, com uma equipe de mais de 4.000 colegas em 22 países, fornecendo serviços abrangentes de ponta a ponta em todo o mundo.

Temos o compromisso de oferecer um atendimento excepcional ao cliente, para permitir que eles se concentrem em seus principais pontos fortes, enquanto confiam suas necessidades de TI à Getronics.

Temos uma oportunidade incrível para você se juntar à nossa equipe, na seguinte vaga:


Vaga Analista BI & Data Visualization - Sênior


O que oferecemos a você:

  • Assistência médica sem desconto para titulares
  • Assistência odontológica sem desconto para titulares
  • Cartão flex tanto para alimentação quanto refeição
  • Auxílio home office para vaga remota
  • Vale transporte para posições presenciais ou híbridas
  • Auxílio creche
  • Seguro de vida
  • Parceria com instituições de ensino

  • Programa de subsídio para aulas de inglês
  • Programa de indicações: prêmio para indicações bem-sucedidas
  • Licença maternidade estendida de 180 dias e a licença paternidade de 20 dias
  • Treinamento completo fornecido como parte de um processo de indução robusto, incluindo oportunidades de desenvolvimento contínuo com nossa plataforma de aprendizado online NorthStar, LinkedIn Learning e Udemy, que possui mais de 80.000 cursos disponíveis


O que esperar desta posição:


Competências Técnicas Obrigatórias:

  • SQL Avançado - consultas complexas, otimização e grandes volumes de dados
  • Experiência sólida com ferramentas de BI (Power BI ou similares)
  • Conhecimento em estatística aplicada - análise descritiva, inferencial e modelagem preditiva
  • Vivência com processos de ETL , integração e limpeza de dados
  • Excel Avançado - tabelas dinâmicas, fórmulas complexas e análise de dados


Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento em Python ou R para análises estatísticas e automação
  • Experiência com modelagem preditiva e machine learning básico
  • Domínio em design de dashboards e storytelling com dados
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais e data warehouses


Responsabilidades Principais:

• Desenvolver e manter dashboards e relatórios em Power BI

• Realizar consultas SQL complexas para extração e análise de dados

• Garantir qualidade, integridade e consistência dos dados

• Apoiar na definição e monitoramento de KPIs e métricas operacionais

• Criar modelos estatísticos e análises preditivas

• Trabalhar com equipes de operações para identificar oportunidades de melhoria baseadas em dados

• Realizar análises estatísticas para suporte à tomada de decisão


Perfil do Candidato:

• Mentalidade analítica e orientada a dados

• Capacidade de traduzir dados em insights acionáveis

• Habilidades de comunicação para apresentar resultados

• Atenção a detalhes e precisão nos dados

• Proatividade na identificação de oportunidades


O que oferecemos:

• Oportunidade de atuar em projetos estratégicos

• Ambiente com foco em data-driven decision making

• Acesso a ferramentas modernas de BI e análise

• Plano de desenvolvimento profissional contínuo

• Benefícios competitivos de mercado

• Trabalho com grandes volumes de dados e desafios complexos


O que esperamos de você:


Ensino superior completo em TI ou áreas correlatas;


Se você acha que possui 75% ou até 90% do que estamos procurando e sabe que é capaz das responsabilidades e deveres desta função, encorajamos você a se candidatar! Isso mostrará sua disposição a se desenvolver, curiosidade para aprender e crescer profissional e pessoalmente.


O que fazer em seguida:

Caso você seja a pessoa que estamos procurando, aguarde nosso contato para te conhecermos melhor e siga as instruções durante o processo seletivo.


Se você gostaria de fazer alguma pergunta sobre nossas vagas, sobre a Getronics como empresa ou qualquer outra coisa, por favor, não hesite em entrar em contato. A equipe de RH estará disponível no e-mail

title: Revenue Operations Associate
description:
About Us:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.

What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals.

From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.

Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:

  • Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention

If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.


About SpendHound:

  • SpendHound is a 100% free software renewal management platform and service recently launched by the research firm YipitData. (See this introductory video from SpendHound’s Senior Product Manager!)
  • SpendHound is the single source of truth for companies’ renewal information and includes:
  • A comprehensive view of all software applications used with annual contract values, auto-renewal information, renewal dates, license counts, and more
  • An invoice and contract management system for companies to store their invoices and contracts
  • Renewal reminders through email and Slack so companies never miss upcoming software renewals
  • Free advice from procurement experts to discuss price benchmarking insights and negotiation strategies for any upcoming renewals
  • Companies use the SpendHound platform and procurement expert service to save time and money on their software renewals.
  • SpendHound is free for customers because customer data is de-identified, aggregated with other panelists, and used as part of YipitData market research (example report ).


About The Role:

Are you a collaborative consulting, analytics, or operations professional with 3+ years of experience, passionate about building a world-class revenue team?

We are seeking a Revenue Operations Associate to play a crucial role in our fast-growing team, SpendHound. As a fast-growing “start-up” within a larger organization, this is a unique opportunity for someone with a strong operational mindset to come in and help build something truly special.


We expect East work hours.


As our Revenue Operations Associate, you will partner with our Sales and Marketing teams to:

  • Be an operations subject matter expert for the Sales function, working closely with RevOps and Spendhound leadership to support Sales and execute on key initiatives
  • Implement processes and solutions that can streamline revenue acquisition and eliminate inefficiencies
  • Maintain and measure various components of the Sales process, such as
  • Target/Territory Management
  • Lead Generation, and
  • Outbound Cadence Operations.
  • Ensure that the Sales teams are operating seamlessly through data evaluation and by improving workflows


You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • Operations professional with 3+ years of experience, passionate about building a world-class revenue team.
  • You demonstrate a high aptitude for organization, process development, project and change management, and analytics
  • You have advanced Excel skills
  • Your experience with CRMs such as Salesforce.com
  • You are willing to become proficient in SQL and data management
  • You are a natural problem-solver, with a keen eye for detail and spotting issues
  • You are committed to continuously improving yourself and helping those around you


What We Offer:

  • Flexible PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits)
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package
  • Remote work
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. See more on our high-impact, high-opportunity work environment above!

Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.

title: ServiceNow Technical Consultant
description:
A Practia está presente em 7 países liderando projetos de automação e transformação digital em grandes clientes. Somos uma das empresas de negócios e tecnologia mais prestigiadas da América Latina com metodologia e equipe técnica especializadas em automação e Hyperautomation.

Possuímos parceria e certificação com as principais plataformas de mercado, atuando como Diamond Partner da UiPath, Platinum Partner da Automation Anywhere, Gold Partner da Microsoft e Silver Partner da IBM. Nossa experiência e vivência em serviços de automação nos garantir, entre diversas premiações, o selo de USN (UiPath Service Network) e LATAM Partner of the Year da UiPath.

Estamos buscando um(a) Desenvolvedor (a) Senior ServiceNow - App Engine & Now Assist , com forte experiência em App Engine e Now Assist para atuar no desenvolvimento de aplicações corporativas, automações inteligentes e soluções baseadas em agentes de IA em um projeto estratégico junto a uma equipe multidisciplinar de analistas, arquitetos e desenvolvedores.


A pessoa selecionada irá atuar em iniciativas avançadas de Hiperautomação e IA, incluindo:

  • Desenvolvimento de soluções para Automação de Processos utilizando a plataforma ServiceNow.
  • Desenvolvimento de aplicações utilizando App Engine Studio (Low-code e High-code).
  • Projetar e implementar workflows, flows e integrações (ITSM, App Engine).
  • Desenvolvimento de scripts para melhor aderência de soluções ao negócio.
  • Atuar na criação de soluções com Now Assist , explorando:
  • Assistentes de IA para ITSM, CSM e processos corporativos.
  • Automação de geração de textos, resumos, classificação e suporte a agentes.
  • Uso de modelos generativos integrados à ServiceNow.
  • Desenvolver componentes em UI Builder / Workspace quando necessário.
  • Trabalhar com scripting em JavaScript (Server e Client Side) .
  • Apoiar na definição de arquitetura de soluções e boas práticas de desenvolvimento na plataforma.
  • Participar de refinamentos técnicos, estimativas e definição de MVPs .
  • Garantir qualidade, segurança e governança das aplicações desenvolvidas.
  • Participação em todo o ciclo de vida de soluções :
  • Discovery técnico
  • Desenho e arquitetura de solução
  • Desenvolvimento
  • Testes e Deploy
  • Hypercare, Orquestração e Sustentação
  • Atuação consultiva com áreas de negócio e TI;
  • Apoio à disseminação de boas práticas de COE de Hiperautomação & IA;
  • Atuar como referência técnica ServiceNow no squad de Delivery;


O que buscamos?

  • Profissional com senioridade e experiência comprovada nos itens citados nesta.
  • Capacidade de liderança técnica;
  • Perfil consultivo, colaborativo e inovador;
  • Gosto por ambientes de alta performance, transparência e confiança;
  • Forte capacidade analítica e visão de soluções aplicadas para os negócios.
  • Comunicação clara com times técnicos e de negócio.
  • Mentalidade de inovação e automação inteligente.

Requisitos da Vaga

  • Experiência comprovada desenvolvimento na plataforma ServiceNow.
  • Experiência comprovada com ServiceNow App Engine / Creator Workflows.
  • Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, UI Policies, Flow Designer e IntegrationHub.
  • JavaScript para ServiceNow.
  • Consumo e exposição de APIs REST.
  • Experiência com Virtual Agent, AI Search, Process Automation Designer, Performance Analytics
  • Vivência em projetos de IA aplicada a processos corporativos.
  • App Engine Studio / Application Developer
  • Now Assist Specialist
  • Experiência com metodologia Ágil (Scrum / Kanban);
  • Certified System Administrator (CSA)
  • Certified Application Developer (CAD)
  • Atuação em Centros de Excelência de RPA & IA.
  • Graduação em Tecnologia, Engenharia ou Administração.


Conhecimentos que podem ser um diferencial para a vaga:

  • ITSM (IT Service Management)
  • ITBM (IT Business Management)
  • SPM(Strategic Porfolio Management)
  • CSM (Customer Service Management)
  • FSM (Field Service Management)
  • ATF (Automated Task Framework)
  • Base de Conhecimento e Configurações da Plataforma (catálogo, SLA, Business rules, Assigment rule, Scheduled Jobs etc.)
  • Service Portal
  • Experiência na plataforma de RPA & IA Automation Anywhere
  • Certificações: Human Resources (CIS-HRSD), IT Service Management (CIS-ITSM), Customer Service Management (CIS-CSM).
  • Vivência com frameworks de governança em ServiceNow.
  • Conhecimento em UX para ServiceNow Workspaces.
  • Conhecimento em:
  • Python
  • .NET
  • Git
  • Inglês.


Contratação PJ.

title: Consultor(a) de Comunicação Interna (Eventos e Comunidade)
description:
A Screencorp é especialista em soluções de Comunicação Interna para aproximar empresas e colaboradores.


Nossa missão é ajudar empresas a se comunicarem melhor com seus colaboradores, fornecendo tecnologia relevante e contextualizada com o objetivo de aumentar engajamento e estabelecer um propósito compartilhado de trabalho.

O Desafio

Você será a \"cara\" da Screencorp para o mercado e para nossa base de clientes.

Seu papel é híbrido: você atuará na educação do mercado através de eventos, no fortalecimento da nossa rede de contatos em RH e na identificação de oportunidades estratégicas dentro dos clientes que já confiam na nossa marca.


Suas Principais Missões:
  • Gestão de Experiências: Planejar e executar o calendário de eventos (webinars, meetups remotos e eventos presenciais de networking) focados em tendências de CI e RH.
  • Fortalecimento de Comunidade: Atuar ativamente em grupos, associações e comunidades de RH/Comunicação para posicionar a Screencorp como autoridade no setor.
  • Faro de Negócios (Growth na Base): Atuar consultivamente com nossos clientes atuais para entender suas dores e identificar momentos ideais para ofertas de upsell (upgrade de plano) ou cross-sell (adoção de novos produtos do ecossistema Screencorp).
  • Embaixador(a) da Marca: Representar a empresa em feiras, congressos e entrevistas para a mídia, disseminando nossa cultura e visão sobre o futuro do trabalho.
  • Produção de Conteúdo Estratégico: Apoiar o time de marketing com insights vindos diretamente da comunidade para a criação de materiais que ajudem na conversão.

    • O que buscamos:
    • Formação em Comunicação Social, Relações Públicas, Jornalismo ou Marketing.
    • Experiência prévia com Organização de Eventos (do planejamento à execução).
    • Perfil \"Hunter\" de Relacionamento: alguém que sinta facilidade em abordar pessoas e construir pontes (Networking).
    • Visão de Negócios: entender que a comunicação deve estar alinhada aos KPIs de vendas e retenção.
    • Excelente oratória e desenvoltura para falar em público e em vídeos.
    • Desejável: Conhecimento prévio do mercado de SaaS ou vivência em RH/Endomarketing.


    Soft Skills que valorizamos:
    • Atitude de Dono: você encara cada evento como um projeto pessoal, agindo com autonomia e proatividade para superar as expectativas.
    • Escuta Ativa: essencial para identificar oportunidades de vendas de forma consultiva e natural.
    • Resiliência: para lidar com a dinâmica de eventos e negociações.
    O que oferecemos:
    • 100% Home Office (não iremos voltar ao presencial)
    • Ambiente respeitoso, informal e pragmático
    • Auxílio Home office
    • Flash Benefícios
    • Plano de saúde Sulamérica
    • Folga no aniversário
    • Enviamos os equipamentos eletrônicos necessários para seu trabalho
    • Contratação CLT

title: Software Engineer Sênior - Vaga afirmativa para pessoas LGBTQIAPN+
description:
A abertura atual é para a Artefact do Brasil, mas estamos em modelo Free Office.
Quem nós somos

Nós da Artefact Brasil acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact !
Quais serão suas atividades;
Como Software Engineer Sênior na Artefact, você será uma peça-chave do nosso time de tecnologia, contribuindo ativamente para o desenho, desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações web complexas que apoiam nossos projetos de dados e insights em múltiplas indústrias.
Você atuará em colaboração com equipes de Data Engineering, Data Science e Consultoria Analítica, garantindo que as soluções sejam escaláveis, seguras e integradas às necessidades reais dos nossos clientes. Além de desenvolver, você será referência técnica, ajudando a definir padrões e boas práticas dentro da equipe.    
Suas principais responsabilidades incluirão:  

  • Liderar o desenvolvimento de aplicações web utilizando JavaScript/TypeScript e frameworks modernos como React e Next.js , priorizando arquitetura limpa, reuso e performance. 
  • Projetar e implementar soluções de integração de dados com bancos relacionais e não relacionais (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Azure Cosmos DB) , com foco em eficiência e escalabilidade.  
  • Gerenciar e otimizar aplicações na nuvem , configurando autenticação, segurança e deploys contínuos em múltiplos provedores cloud, como Azure, GCP e AWS.      
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinar :  transformando modelos e algoritmos de dados em soluções visuais e produtos interativos.      
  • Definir arquitetura de software e padrões técnicos, promovendo boas práticas de DevOps, CI/CD , testes automatizados e versionamento (Git, Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores de diferentes níveis, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração.  
  • Contribuir estrategicamente para decisões de produto, explorando novas tecnologias e garantindo qualidade e sustentabilidade das soluções.


O que nós estamos procurando;    

  • Formação: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou curso na área correlata.      
  • Experiência solida (+5 anos):  em desenvolvimento web com React, Next.js, JavaScript e TypeScript.     
  • Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL , com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance.      
  • Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP) , incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade.
  • Experiência prática com DevOps e CI/CD , uso de Docker , Kubernetes e ferramentas de integração contínua.
  • Visão arquitetural e capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas estratégicas.  
  • Inglês fluente (para interação com equipes e clientes internacionais).


O que oferecemos;       

  • VR/VT       
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)       
  • Gympass       
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico       
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!)       
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)      
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)       

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós;       

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da tecnologia de dados       
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender       
  • Cultura: junte-se à melhor equipe que você poderia imaginar       
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!       

Junte-se a nós!

title: Dax engineer
description:
Job Title: DAX Engineer (Microsoft Dynamics AX 2012)

Industry: Transportation & Supply Chain

Location: Remote


About the Role:

Our client is seeking a skilled DAX Engineer to enhance and maintain their on-prem Microsoft Dynamics AX environment. This role bridges technical development and business operations, working closely with stakeholders across transportation and supply chain functions. The ideal candidate is a Microsoft Dynamics AX specialist with strong technical skills and the ability to translate business needs into practical, scalable solutions.


Key Responsibilities:


Develop, configure, and maintain Microsoft Dynamics AX (AX 2012) solutions to support business operations.


Work within an on-prem AX environment, ensuring stability, reliability, and performance.


Design and implement technical solutions using C# and .NET.


Collaborate with functional teams to understand business requirements and deliver effective solutions.


Support system integrations, customizations, upgrades, and performance optimizations.


Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve application or system issues efficiently.


Document system designs, processes, and best practices to maintain operational clarity.


Contribute to the continuous improvement of AX systems and workflows.


Required Skills & Experience:


Proven experience with Microsoft Dynamics AX (AX 2012).


Hands-on development experience using C# and .NET.


Background as a DAX / Microsoft Engineer, with strong understanding of enterprise systems.


Comfortable in a techno-functional role, engaging both technical and business stakeholders.


Experience supporting on-premise enterprise systems and ensuring operational stability.


Preferred Experience:


Previous exposure to transportation, logistics, or supply chain industries.


Experience with large-scale, enterprise ERP environments.


Understanding of operational workflows in supply chain or freight operations.

title: Revenue Operations Associate
description:
About Us:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.

What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals.

From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.

Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:

  • Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention

If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.


About SpendHound:

  • SpendHound is a 100% free software renewal management platform and service recently launched by the research firm YipitData. (See this introductory video from SpendHound’s Senior Product Manager!)
  • SpendHound is the single source of truth for companies’ renewal information and includes:
  • A comprehensive view of all software applications used with annual contract values, auto-renewal information, renewal dates, license counts, and more
  • An invoice and contract management system for companies to store their invoices and contracts
  • Renewal reminders through email and Slack so companies never miss upcoming software renewals
  • Free advice from procurement experts to discuss price benchmarking insights and negotiation strategies for any upcoming renewals
  • Companies use the SpendHound platform and procurement expert service to save time and money on their software renewals.
  • SpendHound is free for customers because customer data is de-identified, aggregated with other panelists, and used as part of YipitData market research (example report ).


About The Role:

Are you a collaborative consulting, analytics, or operations professional with 3+ years of experience, passionate about building a world-class revenue team?

We are seeking a Revenue Operations Associate to play a crucial role in our fast-growing team, SpendHound. As a fast-growing “start-up” within a larger organization, this is a unique opportunity for someone with a strong operational mindset to come in and help build something truly special.


We expect East work hours.


As our Revenue Operations Associate, you will partner with our Sales and Marketing teams to:

  • Be an operations subject matter expert for the Sales function, working closely with RevOps and Spendhound leadership to support Sales and execute on key initiatives
  • Implement processes and solutions that can streamline revenue acquisition and eliminate inefficiencies
  • Maintain and measure various components of the Sales process, such as
  • Target/Territory Management
  • Lead Generation, and
  • Outbound Cadence Operations.
  • Ensure that the Sales teams are operating seamlessly through data evaluation and by improving workflows


You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • Operations professional with 3+ years of experience, passionate about building a world-class revenue team.
  • You demonstrate a high aptitude for organization, process development, project and change management, and analytics
  • You have advanced Excel skills
  • Your experience with CRMs such as Salesforce.com
  • You are willing to become proficient in SQL and data management
  • You are a natural problem-solver, with a keen eye for detail and spotting issues
  • You are committed to continuously improving yourself and helping those around you


What We Offer:

  • Flexible PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits)
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package
  • Remote work
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. See more on our high-impact, high-opportunity work environment above!

Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.

title: SAP Cloud Architect - SAP Basis
description:
About HCLTech


HCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. We re powered by our people a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 161 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving.


To learn more about how we can supercharge progress for you, visit


Are you an experienced SAP Basis Consultant ready to take the next step in your career? Join our Cloud Architect Advisory (CAA) team as a SAP Cloud Architect, where you'll guide customers through their SAP RISE journey and shape the future of enterprise landscapes.


About the Role


As a SAP Cloud Architect, you’ll be the strategic advisor for customers transitioning to the SAP RISE platform. This customer-facing role involves planning, designing, and presenting SAP landscape architectures tailored to each client’s needs and hyperscaler preferences (AWS, Azure, GCP). You’ll collaborate closely with SAP Sales and Account Executives to ensure technical accuracy and optimal design.


Note: This is a purely architectural role—no hands-on implementation required.


What You’ll Gain


Exposure to cutting-edge SAP technologies: S/4HANA, HANA DB, MDG, Ariba, Salesforce, and more.

Access to SAP’s internal training and learning resources.

Experience across multiple industries and customer landscapes.

A unique opportunity to work on diverse architecture setups not typically available in standard SAP Basis roles.

title: Technical Customer Support Representative (L1)
description:
We are seeking a full-time, remote Technical Customer Support (TCS) Representative with 2+ years of Level 1 support experience, preferably in a doctor's office, veterinary clinic, hospital, or similar healthcare environment. You will use your critical thinking skills to listen to and understand customer needs, offering timely solutions that drive value and customer satisfaction. You will be involved in all aspects of support, including product demonstrations and customer education.

Our client is on a mission to provide technology and services that enable veterinary practices to provide the highest quality of care to pet owners. The company is a well-funded, growth-stage company comprising individuals who thrive in a fast-paced, passionate, and entrepreneurial environment. Our client has thousands of veterinarians in its customer base today (and counting).


Responsibilities

  • Perform core functions of technical support, configuration tasks, and scheduling
  • Maintain high reliability in terms of on-time attendance and availability in assigned channels per shift schedule
  • Provide a timely response and resolution to all inbound customer support (phone, chats, and emails) to understand customer needs and feedback
  • Demonstrate understanding of the client's core products and everyday use cases within the veterinary industry, engaging with customers effectively on their issues
  • Identify the root cause of customer issues, understand the steps to replicate and solve the problem within the client's means, and escalate when not
  • Stay updated on product knowledge to help build and curate knowledge articles
  • Deliver excellent customer experience to clinics and pet owners
  • Ensure root cause and solution are provided consistently
  • Provide all-channel support during designated shift hours:
  • Monday to Friday
  • 7 AM - 4 PM CT (preferred) or 9 AM - 6 PM CT
  • Provide live channel (phone, chat) support during periodic flex times (1 to 2 times per month):
  • Monday to Friday
  • 7 - 8 AM CT or 5 - 6 PM CT
  • Fridays
  • 1 - 2 PM CT or 3 - 4 PM CT


Required Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • 2+ years of Level 1 support for a software-as-a-service (SaaS) product
  • Experience with Zendesk Talk, Messaging, and Support or similar platforms
  • Great attention to detail and strong organizational skills
  • Proven experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently or within a broader team
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • Experience supporting clinician environments, including veterinarian clinics, doctor offices, or hospitals


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and your national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

Modelo híbrido, com presença presencial conforme necessidade das operações.

title: Consultor(a) de Comunicação Interna (Eventos e Comunidade)
description:
A Screencorp é especialista em soluções de Comunicação Interna para aproximar empresas e colaboradores.


Nossa missão é ajudar empresas a se comunicarem melhor com seus colaboradores, fornecendo tecnologia relevante e contextualizada com o objetivo de aumentar engajamento e estabelecer um propósito compartilhado de trabalho.

O Desafio

Você será a \"cara\" da Screencorp para o mercado e para nossa base de clientes.

Seu papel é híbrido: você atuará na educação do mercado através de eventos, no fortalecimento da nossa rede de contatos em RH e na identificação de oportunidades estratégicas dentro dos clientes que já confiam na nossa marca.


Suas Principais Missões:
  • Gestão de Experiências: Planejar e executar o calendário de eventos (webinars, meetups remotos e eventos presenciais de networking) focados em tendências de CI e RH.
  • Fortalecimento de Comunidade: Atuar ativamente em grupos, associações e comunidades de RH/Comunicação para posicionar a Screencorp como autoridade no setor.
  • Faro de Negócios (Growth na Base): Atuar consultivamente com nossos clientes atuais para entender suas dores e identificar momentos ideais para ofertas de upsell (upgrade de plano) ou cross-sell (adoção de novos produtos do ecossistema Screencorp).
  • Embaixador(a) da Marca: Representar a empresa em feiras, congressos e entrevistas para a mídia, disseminando nossa cultura e visão sobre o futuro do trabalho.
  • Produção de Conteúdo Estratégico: Apoiar o time de marketing com insights vindos diretamente da comunidade para a criação de materiais que ajudem na conversão.

    • O que buscamos:
    • Formação em Comunicação Social, Relações Públicas, Jornalismo ou Marketing.
    • Experiência prévia com Organização de Eventos (do planejamento à execução).
    • Perfil \"Hunter\" de Relacionamento: alguém que sinta facilidade em abordar pessoas e construir pontes (Networking).
    • Visão de Negócios: entender que a comunicação deve estar alinhada aos KPIs de vendas e retenção.
    • Excelente oratória e desenvoltura para falar em público e em vídeos.
    • Desejável: Conhecimento prévio do mercado de SaaS ou vivência em RH/Endomarketing.


    Soft Skills que valorizamos:
    • Atitude de Dono: você encara cada evento como um projeto pessoal, agindo com autonomia e proatividade para superar as expectativas.
    • Escuta Ativa: essencial para identificar oportunidades de vendas de forma consultiva e natural.
    • Resiliência: para lidar com a dinâmica de eventos e negociações.
    O que oferecemos:
    • 100% Home Office (não iremos voltar ao presencial)
    • Ambiente respeitoso, informal e pragmático
    • Auxílio Home office
    • Flash Benefícios
    • Plano de saúde Sulamérica
    • Folga no aniversário
    • Enviamos os equipamentos eletrônicos necessários para seu trabalho
    • Contratação CLT

title: Revenue Operations Associate
description:
About Us:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.

What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals.

From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.

Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:

  • Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention

If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.


About SpendHound:

  • SpendHound is a 100% free software renewal management platform and service recently launched by the research firm YipitData. (See this introductory video from SpendHound’s Senior Product Manager!)
  • SpendHound is the single source of truth for companies’ renewal information and includes:
  • A comprehensive view of all software applications used with annual contract values, auto-renewal information, renewal dates, license counts, and more
  • An invoice and contract management system for companies to store their invoices and contracts
  • Renewal reminders through email and Slack so companies never miss upcoming software renewals
  • Free advice from procurement experts to discuss price benchmarking insights and negotiation strategies for any upcoming renewals
  • Companies use the SpendHound platform and procurement expert service to save time and money on their software renewals.
  • SpendHound is free for customers because customer data is de-identified, aggregated with other panelists, and used as part of YipitData market research (example report ).


About The Role:

Are you a collaborative consulting, analytics, or operations professional with 3+ years of experience, passionate about building a world-class revenue team?

We are seeking a Revenue Operations Associate to play a crucial role in our fast-growing team, SpendHound. As a fast-growing “start-up” within a larger organization, this is a unique opportunity for someone with a strong operational mindset to come in and help build something truly special.


We expect East work hours.


As our Revenue Operations Associate, you will partner with our Sales and Marketing teams to:

  • Be an operations subject matter expert for the Sales function, working closely with RevOps and Spendhound leadership to support Sales and execute on key initiatives
  • Implement processes and solutions that can streamline revenue acquisition and eliminate inefficiencies
  • Maintain and measure various components of the Sales process, such as
  • Target/Territory Management
  • Lead Generation, and
  • Outbound Cadence Operations.
  • Ensure that the Sales teams are operating seamlessly through data evaluation and by improving workflows


You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • Operations professional with 3+ years of experience, passionate about building a world-class revenue team.
  • You demonstrate a high aptitude for organization, process development, project and change management, and analytics
  • You have advanced Excel skills
  • Your experience with CRMs such as Salesforce.com
  • You are willing to become proficient in SQL and data management
  • You are a natural problem-solver, with a keen eye for detail and spotting issues
  • You are committed to continuously improving yourself and helping those around you


What We Offer:

  • Flexible PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits)
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package
  • Remote work
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. See more on our high-impact, high-opportunity work environment above!

Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.

description:
About HCLTech


HCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. We re powered by our people a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 161 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving.


To learn more about how we can supercharge progress for you, visit


Are you an experienced SAP Basis Consultant ready to take the next step in your career? Join our Cloud Architect Advisory (CAA) team as a SAP Cloud Architect, where you'll guide customers through their SAP RISE journey and shape the future of enterprise landscapes.


About the Role


As a SAP Cloud Architect, you’ll be the strategic advisor for customers transitioning to the SAP RISE platform. This customer-facing role involves planning, designing, and presenting SAP landscape architectures tailored to each client’s needs and hyperscaler preferences (AWS, Azure, GCP). You’ll collaborate closely with SAP Sales and Account Executives to ensure technical accuracy and optimal design.


Note: This is a purely architectural role—no hands-on implementation required.


What You’ll Gain


Exposure to cutting-edge SAP technologies: S/4HANA, HANA DB, MDG, Ariba, Salesforce, and more.

Access to SAP’s internal training and learning resources.

Experience across multiple industries and customer landscapes.

A unique opportunity to work on diverse architecture setups not typically available in standard SAP Basis roles.

title: ServiceNow Technical Consultant
description:
A Practia está presente em 7 países liderando projetos de automação e transformação digital em grandes clientes. Somos uma das empresas de negócios e tecnologia mais prestigiadas da América Latina com metodologia e equipe técnica especializadas em automação e Hyperautomation.

Possuímos parceria e certificação com as principais plataformas de mercado, atuando como Diamond Partner da UiPath, Platinum Partner da Automation Anywhere, Gold Partner da Microsoft e Silver Partner da IBM. Nossa experiência e vivência em serviços de automação nos garantir, entre diversas premiações, o selo de USN (UiPath Service Network) e LATAM Partner of the Year da UiPath.

Estamos buscando um(a) Desenvolvedor (a) Senior ServiceNow - App Engine & Now Assist , com forte experiência em App Engine e Now Assist para atuar no desenvolvimento de aplicações corporativas, automações inteligentes e soluções baseadas em agentes de IA em um projeto estratégico junto a uma equipe multidisciplinar de analistas, arquitetos e desenvolvedores.


A pessoa selecionada irá atuar em iniciativas avançadas de Hiperautomação e IA, incluindo:

  • Desenvolvimento de soluções para Automação de Processos utilizando a plataforma ServiceNow.
  • Desenvolvimento de aplicações utilizando App Engine Studio (Low-code e High-code).
  • Projetar e implementar workflows, flows e integrações (ITSM, App Engine).
  • Desenvolvimento de scripts para melhor aderência de soluções ao negócio.
  • Atuar na criação de soluções com Now Assist , explorando:
  • Assistentes de IA para ITSM, CSM e processos corporativos.
  • Automação de geração de textos, resumos, classificação e suporte a agentes.
  • Uso de modelos generativos integrados à ServiceNow.
  • Desenvolver componentes em UI Builder / Workspace quando necessário.
  • Trabalhar com scripting em JavaScript (Server e Client Side) .
  • Apoiar na definição de arquitetura de soluções e boas práticas de desenvolvimento na plataforma.
  • Participar de refinamentos técnicos, estimativas e definição de MVPs .
  • Garantir qualidade, segurança e governança das aplicações desenvolvidas.
  • Participação em todo o ciclo de vida de soluções :
  • Discovery técnico
  • Desenho e arquitetura de solução
  • Desenvolvimento
  • Testes e Deploy
  • Hypercare, Orquestração e Sustentação
  • Atuação consultiva com áreas de negócio e TI;
  • Apoio à disseminação de boas práticas de COE de Hiperautomação & IA;
  • Atuar como referência técnica ServiceNow no squad de Delivery;


O que buscamos?

  • Profissional com senioridade e experiência comprovada nos itens citados nesta.
  • Capacidade de liderança técnica;
  • Perfil consultivo, colaborativo e inovador;
  • Gosto por ambientes de alta performance, transparência e confiança;
  • Forte capacidade analítica e visão de soluções aplicadas para os negócios.
  • Comunicação clara com times técnicos e de negócio.
  • Mentalidade de inovação e automação inteligente.

Requisitos da Vaga

  • Experiência comprovada desenvolvimento na plataforma ServiceNow.
  • Experiência comprovada com ServiceNow App Engine / Creator Workflows.
  • Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, UI Policies, Flow Designer e IntegrationHub.
  • JavaScript para ServiceNow.
  • Consumo e exposição de APIs REST.
  • Experiência com Virtual Agent, AI Search, Process Automation Designer, Performance Analytics
  • Vivência em projetos de IA aplicada a processos corporativos.
  • App Engine Studio / Application Developer
  • Now Assist Specialist
  • Experiência com metodologia Ágil (Scrum / Kanban);
  • Certified System Administrator (CSA)
  • Certified Application Developer (CAD)
  • Atuação em Centros de Excelência de RPA & IA.
  • Graduação em Tecnologia, Engenharia ou Administração.


Conhecimentos que podem ser um diferencial para a vaga:

  • ITSM (IT Service Management)
  • ITBM (IT Business Management)
  • SPM(Strategic Porfolio Management)
  • CSM (Customer Service Management)
  • FSM (Field Service Management)
  • ATF (Automated Task Framework)
  • Base de Conhecimento e Configurações da Plataforma (catálogo, SLA, Business rules, Assigment rule, Scheduled Jobs etc.)
  • Service Portal
  • Experiência na plataforma de RPA & IA Automation Anywhere
  • Certificações: Human Resources (CIS-HRSD), IT Service Management (CIS-ITSM), Customer Service Management (CIS-CSM).
  • Vivência com frameworks de governança em ServiceNow.
  • Conhecimento em UX para ServiceNow Workspaces.
  • Conhecimento em:
  • Python
  • .NET
  • Git
  • Inglês.


Contratação PJ.

title: Technical Customer Support Representative (L1)
description:
We are seeking a full-time, remote Technical Customer Support (TCS) Representative with 2+ years of Level 1 support experience, preferably in a doctor's office, veterinary clinic, hospital, or similar healthcare environment. You will use your critical thinking skills to listen to and understand customer needs, offering timely solutions that drive value and customer satisfaction. You will be involved in all aspects of support, including product demonstrations and customer education.

Our client is on a mission to provide technology and services that enable veterinary practices to provide the highest quality of care to pet owners. The company is a well-funded, growth-stage company comprising individuals who thrive in a fast-paced, passionate, and entrepreneurial environment. Our client has thousands of veterinarians in its customer base today (and counting).


Responsibilities

  • Perform core functions of technical support, configuration tasks, and scheduling
  • Maintain high reliability in terms of on-time attendance and availability in assigned channels per shift schedule
  • Provide a timely response and resolution to all inbound customer support (phone, chats, and emails) to understand customer needs and feedback
  • Demonstrate understanding of the client's core products and everyday use cases within the veterinary industry, engaging with customers effectively on their issues
  • Identify the root cause of customer issues, understand the steps to replicate and solve the problem within the client's means, and escalate when not
  • Stay updated on product knowledge to help build and curate knowledge articles
  • Deliver excellent customer experience to clinics and pet owners
  • Ensure root cause and solution are provided consistently
  • Provide all-channel support during designated shift hours:
  • Monday to Friday
  • 7 AM - 4 PM CT (preferred) or 9 AM - 6 PM CT
  • Provide live channel (phone, chat) support during periodic flex times (1 to 2 times per month):
  • Monday to Friday
  • 7 - 8 AM CT or 5 - 6 PM CT
  • Fridays
  • 1 - 2 PM CT or 3 - 4 PM CT


Required Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • 2+ years of Level 1 support for a software-as-a-service (SaaS) product
  • Experience with Zendesk Talk, Messaging, and Support or similar platforms
  • Great attention to detail and strong organizational skills
  • Proven experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently or within a broader team
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • Experience supporting clinician environments, including veterinarian clinics, doctor offices, or hospitals


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and your national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

title: Coordenador de Capital Humano
description:
Sobre a Empresa

Buscamos um(a) Coordenador(a) de Capital Humano para atuar no Brasil, com responsabilidade sobre a coordenação das operações de RH em diferentes unidades operacionais e interface direta com a liderança.


Sobre a Função

A posição exige atuação próxima aos times locais, garantindo conformidade legal, execução eficiente dos processos de RH e alinhamento com as diretrizes corporativas.


Responsabilidades

  • Coordenar as operações de Capital Humano em múltiplas localidades no Brasil
  • Liderar e acompanhar um time de RH distribuído geograficamente
  • Garantir conformidade com a legislação trabalhista brasileira
  • Supervisionar processos de folha, benefícios, relações trabalhistas e ciclo de vida do colaborador
  • Atuar como parceiro(a) de RH para lideranças locais
  • Gerenciar fornecedores e assessorias externas
  • Realizar visitas periódicas às unidades operacionais


Qualificações

  • Formação superior em Recursos Humanos, Administração ou áreas afins
  • Experiência prévia em coordenação de RH no Brasil
  • Conhecimento sólido da legislação trabalhista
  • Experiência em ambientes operacionais ou industriais (desejável)
  • Disponibilidade para viagens
  • Espanhol fluente


Modelo de Trabalho

Modelo híbrido, com presença presencial conforme necessidade das operações.


Confidencialidade

Esta é uma vaga confidencial. Informações adicionais serão compartilhadas ao longo do processo seletivo.

title: Investment Manager (Paid Consultancy Opportunity)
description:
Company - RONIN International is an independent B2B market research company specialising in business, healthcare and tech studies. We are part of the Rippleffect Group (formerly Fat Media Group) and are Company Partners of The Market Research Society (MRS), Corporate Members of ESOMAR, Members of the Insights Association and Council Members of The Interviewer Quality Control Scheme (IQCS).



About - We are looking to speak with Investment decision makers such as Investment Manager, Portfolio Manager, Financial Advisor or Analyst who are working in investment bank, private equity firms, asset management firms or family offices.



Qualifications:

  • The purpose of this study is to gain an understanding of the global awareness of city’s attractiveness in trade, investment and partnership. I believe your opinions and expertise would be valuable for our study and I wonder if you’re interested in taking part.
  • Job titles: Head of Investment, Portfolio Manager or Investment Manager, Wealth Manager, Wealth Advisor, Analyst.
  • The paid consultancy session will be conducted as an informal 30-minute interview conducted via MS Teams and the interview can be held in either English or Portuguese.
  • Please note that, before the final interview, there'll be a 10-minute quick online screener to share more details on the research and to check that this is relevant to you.


Compensation package - BRL 1100 for a 30-minute online interview.

title: Consultor(a) de Comunicação Interna (Eventos e Comunidade)
description:
A Screencorp é especialista em soluções de Comunicação Interna para aproximar empresas e colaboradores.


Nossa missão é ajudar empresas a se comunicarem melhor com seus colaboradores, fornecendo tecnologia relevante e contextualizada com o objetivo de aumentar engajamento e estabelecer um propósito compartilhado de trabalho.

O Desafio

Você será a \"cara\" da Screencorp para o mercado e para nossa base de clientes.

Seu papel é híbrido: você atuará na educação do mercado através de eventos, no fortalecimento da nossa rede de contatos em RH e na identificação de oportunidades estratégicas dentro dos clientes que já confiam na nossa marca.


Suas Principais Missões:
  • Gestão de Experiências: Planejar e executar o calendário de eventos (webinars, meetups remotos e eventos presenciais de networking) focados em tendências de CI e RH.
  • Fortalecimento de Comunidade: Atuar ativamente em grupos, associações e comunidades de RH/Comunicação para posicionar a Screencorp como autoridade no setor.
  • Faro de Negócios (Growth na Base): Atuar consultivamente com nossos clientes atuais para entender suas dores e identificar momentos ideais para ofertas de upsell (upgrade de plano) ou cross-sell (adoção de novos produtos do ecossistema Screencorp).
  • Embaixador(a) da Marca: Representar a empresa em feiras, congressos e entrevistas para a mídia, disseminando nossa cultura e visão sobre o futuro do trabalho.
  • Produção de Conteúdo Estratégico: Apoiar o time de marketing com insights vindos diretamente da comunidade para a criação de materiais que ajudem na conversão.

    • O que buscamos:
    • Formação em Comunicação Social, Relações Públicas, Jornalismo ou Marketing.
    • Experiência prévia com Organização de Eventos (do planejamento à execução).
    • Perfil \"Hunter\" de Relacionamento: alguém que sinta facilidade em abordar pessoas e construir pontes (Networking).
    • Visão de Negócios: entender que a comunicação deve estar alinhada aos KPIs de vendas e retenção.
    • Excelente oratória e desenvoltura para falar em público e em vídeos.
    • Desejável: Conhecimento prévio do mercado de SaaS ou vivência em RH/Endomarketing.


    Soft Skills que valorizamos:
    • Atitude de Dono: você encara cada evento como um projeto pessoal, agindo com autonomia e proatividade para superar as expectativas.
    • Escuta Ativa: essencial para identificar oportunidades de vendas de forma consultiva e natural.
    • Resiliência: para lidar com a dinâmica de eventos e negociações.
    O que oferecemos:
    • 100% Home Office (não iremos voltar ao presencial)
    • Ambiente respeitoso, informal e pragmático
    • Auxílio Home office
    • Flash Benefícios
    • Plano de saúde Sulamérica
    • Folga no aniversário
    • Enviamos os equipamentos eletrônicos necessários para seu trabalho
    • Contratação CLT

title: Revenue Operations Associate
description:
About Us:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.

What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals.

From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.

Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:

  • Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention

If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.


About SpendHound:

  • SpendHound is a 100% free software renewal management platform and service recently launched by the research firm YipitData. (See this introductory video from SpendHound’s Senior Product Manager!)
  • SpendHound is the single source of truth for companies’ renewal information and includes:
  • A comprehensive view of all software applications used with annual contract values, auto-renewal information, renewal dates, license counts, and more
  • An invoice and contract management system for companies to store their invoices and contracts
  • Renewal reminders through email and Slack so companies never miss upcoming software renewals
  • Free advice from procurement experts to discuss price benchmarking insights and negotiation strategies for any upcoming renewals
  • Companies use the SpendHound platform and procurement expert service to save time and money on their software renewals.
  • SpendHound is free for customers because customer data is de-identified, aggregated with other panelists, and used as part of YipitData market research (example report ).


About The Role:

Are you a collaborative consulting, analytics, or operations professional with 3+ years of experience, passionate about building a world-class revenue team?

We are seeking a Revenue Operations Associate to play a crucial role in our fast-growing team, SpendHound. As a fast-growing “start-up” within a larger organization, this is a unique opportunity for someone with a strong operational mindset to come in and help build something truly special.


We expect East work hours.


As our Revenue Operations Associate, you will partner with our Sales and Marketing teams to:

  • Be an operations subject matter expert for the Sales function, working closely with RevOps and Spendhound leadership to support Sales and execute on key initiatives
  • Implement processes and solutions that can streamline revenue acquisition and eliminate inefficiencies
  • Maintain and measure various components of the Sales process, such as
  • Target/Territory Management
  • Lead Generation, and
  • Outbound Cadence Operations.
  • Ensure that the Sales teams are operating seamlessly through data evaluation and by improving workflows


You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • Operations professional with 3+ years of experience, passionate about building a world-class revenue team.
  • You demonstrate a high aptitude for organization, process development, project and change management, and analytics
  • You have advanced Excel skills
  • Your experience with CRMs such as Salesforce.com
  • You are willing to become proficient in SQL and data management
  • You are a natural problem-solver, with a keen eye for detail and spotting issues
  • You are committed to continuously improving yourself and helping those around you


What We Offer:

  • Flexible PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits)
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package
  • Remote work
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. See more on our high-impact, high-opportunity work environment above!

Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.

title: SAP Cloud Architect - SAP Basis
description:
About HCLTech


HCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. We re powered by our people a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 161 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving.


To learn more about how we can supercharge progress for you, visit


Are you an experienced SAP Basis Consultant ready to take the next step in your career? Join our Cloud Architect Advisory (CAA) team as a SAP Cloud Architect, where you'll guide customers through their SAP RISE journey and shape the future of enterprise landscapes.


About the Role


As a SAP Cloud Architect, you’ll be the strategic advisor for customers transitioning to the SAP RISE platform. This customer-facing role involves planning, designing, and presenting SAP landscape architectures tailored to each client’s needs and hyperscaler preferences (AWS, Azure, GCP). You’ll collaborate closely with SAP Sales and Account Executives to ensure technical accuracy and optimal design.


Note: This is a purely architectural role—no hands-on implementation required.


What You’ll Gain


Exposure to cutting-edge SAP technologies: S/4HANA, HANA DB, MDG, Ariba, Salesforce, and more.

Access to SAP’s internal training and learning resources.

Experience across multiple industries and customer landscapes.

A unique opportunity to work on diverse architecture setups not typically available in standard SAP Basis roles.

title: ServiceNow Technical Consultant
description:
A Practia está presente em 7 países liderando projetos de automação e transformação digital em grandes clientes. Somos uma das empresas de negócios e tecnologia mais prestigiadas da América Latina com metodologia e equipe técnica especializadas em automação e Hyperautomation.

Possuímos parceria e certificação com as principais plataformas de mercado, atuando como Diamond Partner da UiPath, Platinum Partner da Automation Anywhere, Gold Partner da Microsoft e Silver Partner da IBM. Nossa experiência e vivência em serviços de automação nos garantir, entre diversas premiações, o selo de USN (UiPath Service Network) e LATAM Partner of the Year da UiPath.

Estamos buscando um(a) Desenvolvedor (a) Senior ServiceNow - App Engine & Now Assist , com forte experiência em App Engine e Now Assist para atuar no desenvolvimento de aplicações corporativas, automações inteligentes e soluções baseadas em agentes de IA em um projeto estratégico junto a uma equipe multidisciplinar de analistas, arquitetos e desenvolvedores.


A pessoa selecionada irá atuar em iniciativas avançadas de Hiperautomação e IA, incluindo:

title: Technical Customer Support Representative (L1)
description:
We are seeking a full-time, remote Technical Customer Support (TCS) Representative with 2+ years of Level 1 support experience, preferably in a doctor's office, veterinary clinic, hospital, or similar healthcare environment. You will use your critical thinking skills to listen to and understand customer needs, offering timely solutions that drive value and customer satisfaction. You will be involved in all aspects of support, including product demonstrations and customer education.

Our client is on a mission to provide technology and services that enable veterinary practices to provide the highest quality of care to pet owners. The company is a well-funded, growth-stage company comprising individuals who thrive in a fast-paced, passionate, and entrepreneurial environment. Our client has thousands of veterinarians in its customer base today (and counting).


Responsibilities

  • Perform core functions of technical support, configuration tasks, and scheduling
  • Maintain high reliability in terms of on-time attendance and availability in assigned channels per shift schedule
  • Provide a timely response and resolution to all inbound customer support (phone, chats, and emails) to understand customer needs and feedback
  • Demonstrate understanding of the client's core products and everyday use cases within the veterinary industry, engaging with customers effectively on their issues
  • Identify the root cause of customer issues, understand the steps to replicate and solve the problem within the client's means, and escalate when not
  • Stay updated on product knowledge to help build and curate knowledge articles
  • Deliver excellent customer experience to clinics and pet owners
  • Ensure root cause and solution are provided consistently
  • Provide all-channel support during designated shift hours:
  • Monday to Friday
  • 7 AM - 4 PM CT (preferred) or 9 AM - 6 PM CT
  • Provide live channel (phone, chat) support during periodic flex times (1 to 2 times per month):
  • Monday to Friday
  • 7 - 8 AM CT or 5 - 6 PM CT
  • Fridays
  • 1 - 2 PM CT or 3 - 4 PM CT


Required Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • 2+ years of Level 1 support for a software-as-a-service (SaaS) product
  • Experience with Zendesk Talk, Messaging, and Support or similar platforms
  • Great attention to detail and strong organizational skills
  • Proven experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently or within a broader team
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • Experience supporting clinician environments, including veterinarian clinics, doctor offices, or hospitals


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and your national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

Modelo híbrido, com presença presencial conforme necessidade das operações.

title: Investment Manager (Paid Consultancy Opportunity)
description:
Company - RONIN International is an independent B2B market research company specialising in business, healthcare and tech studies. We are part of the Rippleffect Group (formerly Fat Media Group) and are Company Partners of The Market Research Society (MRS), Corporate Members of ESOMAR, Members of the Insights Association and Council Members of The Interviewer Quality Control Scheme (IQCS).



About - We are looking to speak with Investment decision makers such as Investment Manager, Portfolio Manager, Financial Advisor or Analyst who are working in investment bank, private equity firms, asset management firms or family offices.



Qualifications:

  • The purpose of this study is to gain an understanding of the global awareness of city’s attractiveness in trade, investment and partnership. I believe your opinions and expertise would be valuable for our study and I wonder if you’re interested in taking part.
  • Job titles: Head of Investment, Portfolio Manager or Investment Manager, Wealth Manager, Wealth Advisor, Analyst.
  • The paid consultancy session will be conducted as an informal 30-minute interview conducted via MS Teams and the interview can be held in either English or Portuguese.
  • Please note that, before the final interview, there'll be a 10-minute quick online screener to share more details on the research and to check that this is relevant to you.


Compensation package - BRL 1100 for a 30-minute online interview.

title: Consultor(a) de Comunicação Interna (Eventos e Comunidade)
description:
A Screencorp é especialista em soluções de Comunicação Interna para aproximar empresas e colaboradores.


Nossa missão é ajudar empresas a se comunicarem melhor com seus colaboradores, fornecendo tecnologia relevante e contextualizada com o objetivo de aumentar engajamento e estabelecer um propósito compartilhado de trabalho.

O Desafio

Você será a \"cara\" da Screencorp para o mercado e para nossa base de clientes.

Seu papel é híbrido: você atuará na educação do mercado através de eventos, no fortalecimento da nossa rede de contatos em RH e na identificação de oportunidades estratégicas dentro dos clientes que já confiam na nossa marca.


Suas Principais Missões:
  • Gestão de Experiências: Planejar e executar o calendário de eventos (webinars, meetups remotos e eventos presenciais de networking) focados em tendências de CI e RH.
  • Fortalecimento de Comunidade: Atuar ativamente em grupos, associações e comunidades de RH/Comunicação para posicionar a Screencorp como autoridade no setor.
  • Faro de Negócios (Growth na Base): Atuar consultivamente com nossos clientes atuais para entender suas dores e identificar momentos ideais para ofertas de upsell (upgrade de plano) ou cross-sell (adoção de novos produtos do ecossistema Screencorp).
  • Embaixador(a) da Marca: Representar a empresa em feiras, congressos e entrevistas para a mídia, disseminando nossa cultura e visão sobre o futuro do trabalho.
  • Produção de Conteúdo Estratégico: Apoiar o time de marketing com insights vindos diretamente da comunidade para a criação de materiais que ajudem na conversão.

    • O que buscamos:
    • Formação em Comunicação Social, Relações Públicas, Jornalismo ou Marketing.
    • Experiência prévia com Organização de Eventos (do planejamento à execução).
    • Perfil \"Hunter\" de Relacionamento: alguém que sinta facilidade em abordar pessoas e construir pontes (Networking).
    • Visão de Negócios: entender que a comunicação deve estar alinhada aos KPIs de vendas e retenção.
    • Excelente oratória e desenvoltura para falar em público e em vídeos.
    • Desejável: Conhecimento prévio do mercado de SaaS ou vivência em RH/Endomarketing.


    Soft Skills que valorizamos:
    • Atitude de Dono: você encara cada evento como um projeto pessoal, agindo com autonomia e proatividade para superar as expectativas.
    • Escuta Ativa: essencial para identificar oportunidades de vendas de forma consultiva e natural.
    • Resiliência: para lidar com a dinâmica de eventos e negociações.
    O que oferecemos:
    • 100% Home Office (não iremos voltar ao presencial)
    • Ambiente respeitoso, informal e pragmático
    • Auxílio Home office
    • Flash Benefícios
    • Plano de saúde Sulamérica
    • Folga no aniversário
    • Enviamos os equipamentos eletrônicos necessários para seu trabalho
    • Contratação CLT
